dossier_meta.paper: Extended VC-dimension, and Radon and Tverberg type theorems for unions …
dossier_meta.statement_text: Determine or estimate the least integer $f=f_{r}(d,s_{1},\ldots,s_{r})$ such that for any set $P$ of $f$ points in $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ there is a partition into $r$ pairwise disjoint sets $P=\bigcup_{i=1}^{r}P_{i}$ such that for any family of sets $C_{1},\ldots,C_{r}$ with $P_{i}\subset C_{i}$ where $C_{i}$ is an $s_{i}$-convex set for every $i\in[r]$ we have that $\bigcap_{i=1}^{r}C_{i}\neq\emptyset$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is a Tverberg-type generalization of Problem 1.3 to $r$ parts and $r$ families of $s_i$-convex sets. Radon's theorem is equivalent to $f(d,1,1)=d+2$ and Tverberg's theorem is equivalent to $f_{r}(d,1,\ldots,1)=(r-1)(d+1)+1$. The paper provides an upper bound via Theorem 1.6 but the exact determination remains open.
